Cars Motorcycles and Marine Engine Trade and Import Co SA Enters Insolvency Proceedings

ATHENS – The Greek automotive sector faces renewed uncertainty as Cars Motorcycles and Marine Engine Trade and Import Co SA, a prominent distributor and importer, entered formal insolvency proceedings this week. The company, which has supplied a broad range of vehicles and marine engines to dealers and fleet operators throughout Greece, has confirmed that it is unable to meet its current financial obligations.

The company’s management issued a statement on Wednesday acknowledging the situation: “We regret to inform our partners and customers that, due to unforeseen financial pressures and a challenging business environment, we have filed for insolvency. Our primary concern is to ensure transparency and to support employees and clients during this process.”

Immediate effects were felt across the company’s operations, with deliveries to dealerships suspended as of Tuesday, according to several local partners. One dealer in Thessaloniki, who asked not to be named, said, “We were notified that pending orders have been put on hold until further notice. This is a significant disruption for us and our customers.”

The company employs approximately 110 staff at its Athens headquarters and regional facilities. The Hellenic Automotive Trade Association expressed concern for the workforce and the wider supply chain. “This insolvency will impact not only direct employees but also numerous service providers, logistics firms, and independent garages,” said association spokesperson Eleni Papadopoulou.

Industry analysts cite rising interest rates, persistent inflation, and supply chain costs as exacerbating factors for automotive distributors in the region. “Many Greek importers are struggling with cash flow after two difficult years,” noted Yiannis Manolidis, an analyst at MarketScope Advisors.

The appointed administrator is currently assessing the company’s assets and liabilities. Uncertainty surrounds the fate of outstanding warranties and after-sales support. Unions representing affected staff have called for urgent talks to safeguard jobs.

Cars Motorcycles and Marine Engine Trade and Import Co SA has not provided a timeline for the completion of the insolvency process. Further updates are expected as proceedings continue.
